subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class session process-event contract now, and if so should it be a new `process.*`/`step.*` protocol family or a normalized projection of existing agent item/plan/tool/lifecycle streams?
rationale: This would become a core gateway/session API and could expose sensitive intermediate run state, so automation cannot safely choose the taxonomy, replay model, or security boundary without maintainer direction.

options.title: Design additive process events
options.body: Create a new permission-checked process-event contract with stable ids, replay semantics, and redacted mappings from existing streams before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to existing streams
options.body: Treat current item/plan/tool/lifecycle streams as the permanent source and only add missing normalization and replay fields there.

options.title: Defer to narrower trackers
options.body: Leave this broad contract open or deprioritized while narrower issues handle `sessions_send`, Codex UI progress, and CLI stdout streaming separately.

recommendation.title: Design additive process events
recommendation.body: Create a new permission-checked process-event contract with stable ids, replay semantics, and redacted mappings from existing streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent history signal on the central agent-events and gateway/session surfaces affected by the product/API choice.
